dedupe_keys.name: simulation dataset for an extended agent based evacuation framework integrating cognitive emotional and personality mechanisms

description: Zoi Lygizou and colleagues publish outputs and parameter configurations for six agent-based evacuation experiments involving cognition, emotion and personality. Zenodo supplies one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The author description says the package has CSV simulation results and the settings used for each experimental condition. A modeller can compare outcome sensitivity to behavioural assumptions or use the outputs as a reference when testing a new evacuation agent model. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this six-experiment release. A limitation is that the authors explicitly exclude the simulation source code, so the original process cannot be rerun from this deposit alone. The public page does not give building geometry, time step, agent count or outcome-variable names. The archive was not downloaded, and neither parameter values nor reported experiment results were independently checked.
